requirements.verifier_assertion: The gen-LLM checklist is built from instruction.md, whose Objective anchors every downstream visual/interaction item: an immersive, real-time interactive environment that simulates a mangrove swamp with visual fidelity and intuitive user interaction.

Core Requirement 1 seeds root-visualization checklist items: high-detail root models with realistic bark textures, navigable around/under/over, and a proximity-reactive subtle sway (the fallback checklist reserves an explicit 'root sway' item for the artifact to satisfy).
must_include: navigate around, under, and over the roots

requirements.verifier_assertion: Core Requirement 2 seeds water-shader checklist items: a real-time ripple shader driven by user movement, object interactions, and wind, with layered (surface/subsurface) propagation and light refraction (the fallback checklist reserves an explicit 'water ripples' item).
must_include: user movement, object interactions, and wind parameters

requirements.verifier_assertion: Core Requirement 3 seeds fish-parallax checklist items: multi-layered depth reveals schools of fish at angle / when light shafts penetrate, animating organically to currents and user presence (the fallback checklist reserves an explicit 'fish scatter' item).
must_include: light shafts penetrate the water column

requirements.verifier_assertion: Core Requirement 4 seeds ambient-audio & lighting checklist items: spatialized wildlife sounds (bird calls, insects, fauna) and dynamic light shafts filtering through canopy that react to time-of-day (the fallback checklist reserves 'sound-btn', 'underwater overlay', and time-slider items).
must_include: Dynamic light shafts filtering through canopy

requirements.verifier_assertion: Core Requirement 5 and the Performance section seed perf checklist items and drive the visible FPS HUD (the fallback checklist reserves a #fps HUD item): 90 FPS on high-end VR (Oculus Quest Pro, Valve Index), >=60 FPS on mid-range PC, LOD / instancing / culling, adaptive shader/particle complexity, stable frame rates through dense root areas.

Deliverables list seeds coverage checklist items: full 3D scene package (assets + shaders + scripts), documentation covering setup / performance tuning / interaction controls, and a build for both standalone VR and PC-based VR platforms — the descope in 4.2.2 is delivered against this exact scope.
must_include: Documentation covering setup, performance tuning, and interaction controls
standalone VR and PC-based VR platforms

requirements.verifier_assertion: The five-milestone timeline (M1..M5) shapes the checklist's coverage expectations across topology, ripple shader, fish/lighting/audio, VR interaction+optimization, and final polish/docs/builds; the closing account is judged against this scope roll-up.
must_include: Procedural water ripple and shader implementation
Fish behavior, lighting, and ambient audio
VR interaction, optimization, and performance testing
Final polish, documentation, and platform builds

requirements.verifier_assertion: The Interaction section seeds control/affordance checklist items (fallback reserves #time-slider, #wind-slider, #tour-btn): free movement via VR controllers or desktop controls, touching water creates visible ripples, approaching roots/fish triggers subtle reactions, and a time-of-day control cycles morning / afternoon / sunset / night.
must_include: VR controllers or standard desktop controls

requirements.verifier_assertion: The Visual Details section seeds visual-fidelity checklist items (fallback reserves an underwater overlay item): muddy water + floating debris + wet roots + leaves, subtle water reflections + shadows + fog + floating particles, and fish that occasionally disappear behind roots or into darker areas.
must_include: muddy water, floating debris, wet roots, leaves
subtle water reflections, shadows, fog, and floating particles
Fish should occasionally disappear behind roots

requirements.verifier_assertion: tests/iv_verify.py picks an HTML entry via _pick_entry from the workspace and drives it in headless Chromium; no index.html at the workspace root -> NoArtifact -> reward 0.0. The delivery medium is not literally in the brief and must be supplied by the simulator: single self-contained index.html at the workspace root, anything else scores zero.
index.html renders the interactive browser scene without network access or an install step; CDN failure/static error fallback is not a functional delivery.
